homepage_blueprint.description: Full-width smooth carousel featuring seasonal customized cakes, artisanal hampers, and fresh daily bakes with gold accent overlay and clear CTA 'Order Fresh Cake'.
Round imagery thumbnails of categories (Cakes, Hampers, Pastries, Breads, Cookies, Custom Orders) with subtle hover scale effect.
Cards with creamy background (#FAF6EF), subtle shadow, weight/size variant selector (0.5kg, 1kg, 2kg), eggless badge toggle, price tag in brand pink (#D81B60), and 'Add to Cart' button.
A dedicated high-impact section where users can customize tier (1, 2, 3), flavor, occasion, message on cake, upload reference photo, and pick delivery date & time in Pathankot.
Promotional highlight of festive & wedding hampers packed with dry cakes, artisanal cookies, chocolates, and personalized notes.
Illustrative badges for 100% Fresh Daily, Express 2-Hour Delivery in Pathankot, 100% Eggless Available, and Handcrafted with Love.
Minimal clean cards featuring authentic customer reviews and ratings.
bg-[#8FC3B4] text-[#2A2421] section with Useful Links, Payment Icons, Store Location in Pathankot, Operating Hours, and Social Media links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow `.js` React syntax (NOT `.tsx` / TypeScript). Keep code clean and modern.
Use the mint green (#8FC3B4), brand pink (#D81B60), gold (#B8860B), and warm cream (#FDFBF7 / #FAF6EF) palette consistently across the app.
All headings must adopt centered section formatting with gold diamond glyphs (♦ ♦ ♦) or elegant line accents.
Header must feature the mint background, rounded pink logo badge, pill search bar, and black quick-cart button with live item counter badge.
Ensure the Custom Cake Builder form is fully interactive with weight, flavor, tier selection, image preview mock, date picker, and direct instant quote / cart integration.
Include filters for Eggless / Contains Egg, Price range, Category, and Weight on product catalog pages.

Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, filter, and link contains a clear `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid='add-to-cart-button'`, `data-testid='search-input'`, `data-testid='custom-cake-submit'`).
Use Sonner for toast notifications when items are added to cart, custom cake inquiry submitted, or order placed.
